title: NIST WebBook: Ethane gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion
summary: The WebBook lists 3 gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion row(s) for Ethane. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of combustion rows for Ethane (CAS 74-84-0) print: -1560.7 ± 0.3 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Pittam and Pilcher, 1972, comment: Corresponding Δ f Hº gas = -83.85 kJ/mol (simple calculation by NIST; no Washburn corrections); ALS (experimental or compiled row) | -1559.9 ± 0.46 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Prosen and Rossini, 1945, comment: Hf derived from Heat of Hydrogenation; Corresponding Δ f Hº gas = -84.64 kJ/mol (simple calculation by NIST; no Washburn corrections); ALS (experimental or compiled row) | -1559.8 ± 0.46 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Rossini, 1934, comment: Corresponding Δ f Hº gas = -84.68 kJ/mol (simple calculation by NIST; no Washburn corrections); ALS (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
